# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secrets (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secrets" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secrets" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  credential_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

## Schema

Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "created_at".
